Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(i|i.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and
		item.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		item.StockNumber>0 and
		quantity>0
	postcondition:
		let newSalesLineItem: SalesLineItem in
		newSalesLineItem.oclIsNew() and
		SalesLineItem.allInstance()->includes(newSalesLineItem) and
		self.CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(newSalesLineItem) and
		newSalesLineItem.BelongedSale = self.CurrentSale and
		newSalesLineItem.BelongedItem = item and
		newSalesLineItem.Quantity = quantity and
		item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber-quantity and
		newSalesLineItem.Subamount = item.Price*quantity and
		result = true
}
